concepts.gloss_en: the spirit/breath of life (construct, indefinite) — identified in LM 1:8 with erech apayim (patience)
the spirit of THE life (definite) — 'ruach ha-chaim di-kdusha', the holy life-spirit; article-marked variant

members.note: representative; definite article on the second (construct-tail) word may narrow the referent to the specific holy life-spirit

notes: Both forms occur in LM 1:8 and plausibly denote the same 'spirit of life' motif, but they differ by the definite article on חיים (רוח חיים vs רוח החיים). Per the definite-article rule and under-merge-beats-over-merge, kept separate; a human should decide whether the single רוח החיים usage ('רוח הַחַיִּים דִּקְדֻשָּׁה') is truly identical to the indefinite רוח חיים archetype or a deliberately marked variant.
